A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed an architecture for reinforcement learning that allows us to decompose the reward function into a number of smaller components and learn a separate value function and policy for each component.
HRA is a generalisation of the reward decomposition approach and it is a more stable method to learn the value functions.
HRA is a generalisation method that can be applied to any RL algorithm and any decomposed reward function.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the value function can be learned more efficiently when the rewards are structured, and that HRA is a promising approach for tackling challenging RL domains where the optimal action-value function is difficult to approximate.
